crisis_windows: Market drawdown episodes of at least 15% inside the test period, from the running peak to the trough (rule applied to the market index only).
decision_rule: All verdicts are reported as they come out, whether supported or not. No parameter, method or hypothesis may be changed after this sample is run.
eligibility: Same 95% rule; industries without data in the look-back are simply not eligible.
hypotheses: H1-H7 with the same tests and decision rules as in the specification.
method_and_parameters: Unchanged: specification a1be5ab38d9e20b6 (primary B-SR-DAS, secondary S-SR-DAS, all comparison methods, k=10, L=1260, h=63, costs 10 bps, equal weights).
sample: Fama-French 49 industry portfolios, daily, value-weighted; data from 1926-07-01 (look-back), test period 1931-07-01 to 1969-12-31
status_of_period: Never used before for any out-of-sample evaluation. Earlier work used data from 1963-07 only as look-back for the 1970 holdout and for a descriptive correlation figure from 1965.
title: Addendum 1 to specification a1be5ab38d9e20b6: second confirmatory sample
written: 2026-10-13, before any strategy was evaluated on this period
